purpose: Stage 0.5 item 3: the G0 near batch under the series kernel K_v2 and the K2 hand rule v2. G0 leaves do not call the K3 primitive (locate stays the colour rule, design §1.6), so this checks decision equivalence with K_v1 and rebuilds the entry library checkpoints under K_v2 + hand rule v2. Same bundle, generator spec, seeds and episode caps as the K_v1 near batch.
instance_note: Same seeds as the stage-0 near batch on purpose: a paired rerun under the new kernel and hand rule, not resampling. No seed is added or replaced.

baselines.negative: 2 s wait on the first ready instance of each template; any goal satisfaction under hand rule v2 invalidates the whole batch
baselines.engineering: fixed G0 tool chain under K_v2 (TP01: locate,grasp; TP03/TP04: locate,grasp,place), colour-rule locate, no model call
baselines.paired: outputs/tabletop_kernel_near_20261115_002 (K_v1, hand rule v1) and its v2 replay outputs/tabletop_rejudge_20261117_001

gate: Run only if tabletop_rejudge_20261117_001 triggers none of its falsification conditions.
prediction: Every instance, readiness and robot initial hash equals the K_v1 near batch; no episode calls the model (no vlm_calls.json, no vlm_cache).

Every episode reproduces its K_v1 episode (checked by tabletop_rejudge_20261117_002): state arrays byte-equal, actions and execution equal, verdict_v1.json equal to the recorded verdict, verdict.json and tool truth equal to the v2 replay, result counts equal.
Full success per group therefore equals the K_v1 batch plus the verdict flips of the v2 replay.
falsification: Any differing episode: K_v2 changed G0 behaviour, so the stage-0 baseline is not carried over to K_v2 and these checkpoints are not used as an entry library until the cause is found.
Negative control satisfies a goal: the whole batch is invalid.
A system execution failure or KERNEL_CHANGED_AFTER_PREPARE.
